score_reasons.quality: Very clean high-tech 3D render: crisp component edges, believable studio lighting with a glowing blue rim accent on the visor, convincing materials across plastic, PCB, glass lenses and fabric cushion textures. Minor deductions for slight ambiguity where the top strap merges into the visor layer and a slightly spongy seam on the facial cushions.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Excellent advertisement-grade composition: soft purple-blue gradient field, vertically centered exploded stack with balanced three-left/five-right callout columns, blue leader lines that integrate labels without clutter, and a strong type hierarchy from header to footer. Cohesive and premium throughout.
score_reasons.alignment: Nearly everything specified is delivered: header '∞ Meta Quest 3', the Japanese subtitle, a vertically stacked exploded view with the required component layers (shell, camera pods, motherboard with chip, pancake lenses, internal frame, battery packs, side straps, facial interface cushions), all 8 callout labels (3 left, 5 right) rendered with the exact specified Japanese copy, footer headline, footer body text, and '∞ Meta' logo. Only minor gap: the 'top strap' ninth layer is not clearly separated as its own exploded stage.
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: Grounded in the real product: Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 is the actual chip, pancake lenses and IPD adjustment are real features, and the infinity-mark Meta branding is accurate. Stylizations vs the physical device (four exposed camera pods, two discrete battery packs) are acceptable in an exploded-diagram genre; no cultural or factual text errors found.
score_reasons.creative_generation: Executes the promo-diagram genre with confidence: seamless fusion of render and typography, disciplined information hierarchy guiding eye from title down the stack to the closing headline, and leader lines that read as professional technical illustration. Imagination is bounded by the template brief, so it impresses more on execution than originality.

unfulfilled_requirements: Top strap not presented as a clearly separated ninth exploded layer (merged with the visor stage)
